title: team.delete_person_data reply
description: Counts of removed blob ownership records, deleted and kept blobs, and deleted and kept raw dead-letter copies; returns retry_later with cumulative progress counts when a bounded dead-letter scan reaches its time budget while one background continuation per (team, person) finishes the pass.

owners_removed.description: Blob ownership records removed for the departing person during this cleanup.

blobs_kept.description: Blobs referencing this person that were kept because another owner still holds them.

dlq_copies_kept.description: Raw dead-letter copies scanned during this cleanup that did not name the departing person and were kept.
